title: Intern (Offshore desk)
description:
Company Overview

Offering a complete ecosystem of maritime services, including broking, finance, port services and research, Clarksons is at the heart of global shipping. Our unrivalled reach, expertise, and depth of experience, combined with leading research, enables us to partner with clients across every sector to meet the demands of the world's rapidly evolving maritime, offshore, trade and energy markets. Building on our unique heritage and harnessing our insights to see further, faster, we work with our clients and communities to create strategies that have a positive impact on the industry and the world around us. Dedicated to excellence, it's our people that drive success for our clients.

To understand more including day-to-day life at Clarksons, visit us at

Division Overview

The Offshore group has vast expertise in brokerage and serves the shipping and offshore industry worldwide by providing shipbrokering services within chartering, sale and purchase and contracting of ships and offshore units. We maintain a strong relationship and extensive communication with the majority of the world's leading shipowners and oil companies which represents a considerable source of business opportunities.

Discover more at

Role Summary

We have a fantastic opportunity for a college student to join our Offshore team in Rio De Janeiro. The person in this role will carry out post-fixture operations and accounts receivable duties. This includes being responsible for collecting information from each fixture from the Offshore desk, inputting details into an internal system, and producing on-demand reports for the Accounts team. You will be required to liaise with brokers and the Accounts department, with a focus on being a key point of contact for the Accounts Receivables team.

The successful candidate should be organized, highly responsive and diligent, able to apply strong attention to detail and accuracy. This role would suit someone who is self-motivated and proactive and can deliver a variety of tasks in a busy and fast-paced environment. We are looking for someone who is able to work autonomously to deadlines and enjoys being a valued member of the team.

What you'll be doing

Post-Fixture Operations Duties

  • Carry out various post-fixture duties.
  • Check all documents related to the fixtures are in accordance with the standards and needs.
  • Request fixture documents from brokers and/or clients, managing internal and external communication.
  • Input and update relevant data from the fixtures into internal systems, including contractual, financial documentation.
  • Follow up vessels 'on-hire' and 'off-hire' with brokers and clients.
  • Check hire invoices, ensuring they are accurate and issued on time, and chase for payment if needed.

Accounts Receivable Duties

  • Organizing, raising and processing monthly and ad-hoc invoicing to clients;
  • Produce Accounts Receivable ad-hoc reports for the Offshore and Accounts departments.

General Duties

  • Provide administrative assistance to our Offshore chartering team in general terms.
  • Addition ad / hoc duties as needed in order to meet the needs of the business.

What we're looking for

We welcome applications from candidates who share our Company Values and key attributes, as follows:

  • Integrity and respect
    – acting thoughtfully and ethically to do the right thing in accordance with Conduct Rules, and to promote and foster a respectful work environment for all.
  • Drive
    – self-motivation and the desire and commitment to succeed, deliver excellence and make positive change.
  • Relationship building
    – excellent communicator to effectively build strong, long-lasting relationships with colleagues, clients and others.
  • Collaboration
    – working well with others across diverse backgrounds to share information, develop skills and deliver results.
  • Resilience
  • persisting and adapting to changing or difficult situations, and adopting a positive and focused approach.
  • Smart
  • problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a curious and inquisitive mind, and an openness to new ideas.

Other requirements

  • Business, Economy or Accounting undergraduate students (preferable).
  • Experience of carrying out administrative duties (beneficial).
  • Experience / knowledge within Oil and Gas market is welcome (not mandatory).
  • Highly responsive, and a strong communicator, both verbal and written.
  • Able to build strong relationships, and comfortable communicating with senior colleagues.
  • Highly organized with excellent time management skills.
  • Must be a team player and able to collaborate and work well as part of a results-oriented, office-based workplace.
  • Self-motivated, diligent and able to work well under pressure.
  • Strong focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Able to use MS office packages (inc. outlook, excel, word).
  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written.

title: Coordenador de implantação
description:
This position will be hired on an outsourcing basis, with an attractive salary and benefits package.
Job Description
Position Mission
Lead the deployment of telecommunications products and services by aligning internal demands with customer objectives, developing detailed implementation planning, distributing activities, and managing resources to ensure delivery within defined timelines and budgets. Proactively mitigate risks while ensuring full compliance with internal and external quality, safety, and acceptance procedures.
Guarantee the effective execution of all field activities, directly supporting subcontractors and technical teams in the resolution of operational challenges, and ensuring full compliance with safety, quality, and customer acceptance procedures.
Key Responsibilities
Internal Coordination
· Validate internal demands and ensure compliance with internal and customer standards.
· Plan deployment activities based on resources, priorities, and project needs.
· Align periodically with internal teams on priorities and timelines.
· Update KPIs, project progress, and reports daily in internal and customer systems.
· Conduct audits and site visits to ensure safety, quality, and acceptance standards.
Customer Alignment
Align internal efforts with customer goals, negotiating priority changes when needed. Monitor the progress of customer-side prerequisites such as infrastructure readiness, transmission availability, and access authorizations.
Participate actively in meetings, conferences, and events—both internal and customer-driven—whether in person or online, especially those involving compliance and audit processes.
Subcontractor Management
· Ensure field activities are executed as planned, providing on-site support, removing blockers, and escalating issues to meet delivery targets.
· Monitor subcontractor teams daily, tracking progress, adjusting priorities, and escalating issues to ensure deadlines and budgets are met.
· Act as a technical coach, guiding subcontractors to ensure safe, compliant, and effective execution.
Governance and Compliance
Timely issuance of all reports, documents, and tickets as required by internal and customer procedures, following the approved formats and content standards.
Ensure that all stakeholders (internal teams, subcontractors, and customers) comply with legal, regulatory, and procedural requirements—particularly in the areas of compliance, security, and auditing.
Field Execution Oversight
Be the primary operational lead responsible for ensuring all deployment activities are executed in the field as planned.
Anticipate and resolve execution challenges through direct interaction with subcontractors and technical supervisors.
Monitor work quality, field conditions, safety protocols, and scheduling adherence on a daily basis.
Requirements
Technical degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related fields.
Associate (Technologist) or Bachelor's degree is highly desirable.
Advanced English
5+ years of experience in the telecom industry.
2+ years of experience as a deployment supervisor or senior deployment analyst.
Experience working in or for a telecom carrier or vendor.
Proven experience in coordinating 10+ field teams simultaneously.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Basic knowledge of project management (certification is a plus).
Understanding of wireless and/or bearer network engineering (installation) fundamentals.
If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you

Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, raça, idade, identidade, orientação ou condição.

Formato de contratação: CLT ou PJ 

Responsabilidades 

  • Atuar como referência funcional de Crédito & Cobrança no SAP FICA dentro do stack comercial-regulatório Utilities, assegurando aderência às melhores práticas do S/4HANA, governança de Clean Core e sustentação do ciclo de inadimplência end-to-end.
  • Desenhar e parametrizar processos de concessão de crédito, scoring, bloqueio, desligamento e régua de cobrança (pré, extra e judicial).
  • Implementar estratégias de cobrança integradas aos módulos FI-CA, FI-AR e CRM/CS.
  • Construir e validar regras BRF+ para políticas de cobrança e dunning.
  • Liderar análises de débito crítico, aging, write-off, renegociação e acordos.
  • Garantir compliance com normas da Aneel, Procon e legislações estaduais.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e integrar com equipes de Billing, DM, CS, Medição e Faturamento.
  • Conduzir testes integrados, homologação e suporte às etapas de Cutover e PGLS.

Requisitos 

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP IS-U/S4 FI-CA, com foco em Crédito & Cobrança.
  • Forte domínio dos processos de Dunning, Collections, Promise-to-Pay e Cálculo de Juros.
  • Conhecimento de interfaces críticas, como Bad Debt, Call Center e Payment Arrangements.
  • Vivência em projetos Greenfield, Clean Core, BRF+ e Utilities Billing.
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente regulado e de alta cadência.

They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables:

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables:

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID's
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to:

Functional: Director ROV Operations

Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations

Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

About Us
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

description:
Job Description
Do you have a strong telecom engineering background and experience working with international customers? Do you want to be part of a global consulting organization while supporting a world-class telecom provider? Then this role is for you.
Tietoevry Create is looking for a Senior Telco Service Engineer to work on a strategic engagement with BICS, a global leader in international communications services. You will operate in a customer-facing, technically demanding role, ensuring high-quality service delivery across BICS' international telecom portfolio.
This position is based in Rio de Janeiro and operates in a global, multicultural environment, working closely with international customers and cross-functional teams.
Your Responsibilities
Act as the main operational point of contact for selected international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' telecom services.
Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive engagement and customized operational interfaces, in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.
Prepare and present monthly service performance reports and lead Service Review Meetings, driving continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.
Serve as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents and escalations, coordinating resolution activities and delivering formal RFO/RCA documentation.
Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, supporting adoption of BICS' global offerings.
Collect and share customer feedback internally to support operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
Develop and maintain operational documentation, including service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices.
Who We Are Looking For
Solid experience in the telecom industry, combining strong technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities.
Proven technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and structured approach.
Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage complex service issues and escalations.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.
University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.
Flexibility and accountability, including willingness to travel internationally when required.
Strong crisis and incident management capabilities.
As a person, you are reliable, structured, and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and value operational discipline and continuous improvement.
We also value
Experience working with international enterprise or carrier customers.
Familiarity with SLA-driven service environments and operational reporting.
Ability to work closely with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
We offer
Professional growth within a global consulting organization.
Long-term, meaningful projects with leading international clients.
Open and collaborative culture with strong knowledge sharing.
Flexible hybrid work model and focus on work-life balance.
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.
Additional Information
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Engenheiro de Petróleo
description:
REQUISITOS MANDATÓRIOS

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • 3 anos na área de planejamento e/ou acompanhamento da construção, abandono ou workover de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de simulação para análise de risco tais como: Well Cost Deterministic Pkg e Well Cost Advanced Pkg ou Genesis PFU (Completions Planning and Follow-up), Genesis Drilling e Genesis IVAC, mas não limitados a estes, comprovados por declaração da empresa contratada ou por declaração do antigo empregador;
  • Na parte de Dados: tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística e árvore de decisão;
  • Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Nível de Formação: Superior em Engenharia, devidamente registrados no Conselho Regional da área.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criação, manutenção, atualização e migração de bancos de dados utilizados como base de conhecimento;
  • Gestão do Conhecimento de Campo: Análise contínua dos dados de intervenções de poços para organização e disponibilização estruturada das informações, desenvolvimento de análises para identificar correlações entre dados relevantes para planejamento e avaliação de riscos e avaliação de anormalidades nas intervenções, visando identificar tendências relacionadas à fase executada, à formação perfurada e às condições operacionais;
  • Análise técnica da informação preenchida no ou outro sistema adotado: Análise das intervenções, comunicação de divergências e garantia de convergência das informações e solicitação para implementação de alterações no banco de dados;
  • Controle de Qualidade das Bases de Dados dos Boletins de Intervenções em Poços: Utilização de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial e Business Intelligence para validação de dados, registro e manutenção da estruturação, taxonomia e ontologia dos dados e proposição de ajustes nos padrões e manuais;
  • Base Estatística dos Tempos das Operações: Criação e manutenção da base de dados históricos para análise da duração das operações, diferenciando tempos úteis e perdidos para composição de distribuições probabilísticas;
  • Apoio ao Planejamento de Intervenções: Organização e validação de informações para planejamento de intervenções futuras, análise de insumos, verificação da completude e validação das datas de início fim do estudo, simulação de duração das operações utilizando software específico e elaboração de relatórios conforme padrões estabelecidos e validados;
  • Análise Semestral e Plurianual de Controle de Processo: Avaliação da evolução temporal das operações e identificação de tendências para aprimoramento do processo;
  • Análise Específica: Estudo detalhado das características, tempos e anomalias das operações para identificação de padrões, correlações e tendências para um determinado período, campo ou bacia, podendo envolver dados internos ou externos;
  • Acompanhamento de Campanhas: Monitoramento do progresso das campanhas, atualização de projeções e análise de desvios em relação ao planejamento;
  • Desempenho de Operações Submarinas: Medidas de duração das operações submarinas segmentadas conforme a ontologia estabelecida e comparativo de desempenho entre prestadores de serviços, incluindo análises gráficas (boxplots);
  • Planejamento de Campanhas: Uso da base de conhecimento operacional para estimativas de duração, planejamento e análise técnico-econômica das campanhas.
  • Análise, suporte, revisão e elaboração de documentos técnicos;
  • Levantamento, tratamento e consolidação de dados;
  • Estudos comparativos de estimativas de duração;
  • Suporte técnico em governança de grupos temáticos e revisão de procedimentos técnicos;
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento de ações de pesquisa e desenvolvimento;
  • Avaliação de viabilidade técnica e econômica de tecnologias;
  • Atualização de configurações de poços em bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de orçamentação para estimativas de duração, quando necessário;
  • Alimentação de bases de dados externas com informações obtidas nas bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de acesso aos aplicativos e sistemas utilizados para execução dos serviços contratados.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Performance
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Planejamento e Performance Comercial com visão estratégica e forte capacidade analítica, para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence (BI) e otimização dos processos comerciais da empresa. Este papel é essencial para garantir o acompanhamento de vendas, metas e indicadores de performance, além de apoiar a análise de dados para tomada de decisões mais assertivas.

Além de contribuir com o monitoramento contínuo de resultados e performance comercial, você será responsável pela implementação e atualização dos relatórios de BI, análise de dados comerciais e pela identificação de lacunas e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de vendas. Seu trabalho ajudará a estruturar ações estratégicas baseadas em dados, promovendo a evolução contínua da performance comercial e corporativa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar relatórios e dashboards utilizando Business Intelligence (BI) para análise detalhada de dados comerciais, proporcionando insights estratégicos para as equipes de vendas e liderança.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das vendas e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas, identificando padrões e comportamentos de vendas para otimização de resultados.
  • Monitorar e atualizar constantemente o painel de metas e indicadores de performance de todos os departamentos, tanto corporativo quanto comercial, garantindo a precisão dos dados e a transparência na comunicação dos resultados.
  • Realizar a homologação de dados junto à supervisão comercial, com base nas análises de dados comerciais, para determinar as necessidades de recursos humanos (colaboradores) necessários para o atendimento da demanda.
  • Estudar e identificar lacunas operacionais e comerciais, propondo e implementando ações corretivas e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Marketing, Comercial e Recursos Humanos, para garantir que as metas sejam alcançadas e que as estratégias estejam alinhadas com as necessidades do mercado.
  • Criar análises de tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor, com base nos dados coletados, para apoiar decisões comerciais mais assertivas e identificar oportunidades de vendas.
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade de novas oportunidades de negócios, com base nas análises de dados, propondo ajustes nas estratégias comerciais.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de planejamento estratégico a partir das análises de performance e indicadores de vendas.
  • Garantir que as estratégias de vendas sejam baseadas em dados, colaborando com os times para maximizar os resultados.
  • Contribuir para a definição e acompanhamento de projeções comerciais, oferecendo insights sobre previsões de vendas e alocação de recursos.
  • Realizar apresentações periódicas de resultados e sugestões de melhorias para as equipes de liderança e stakeholders.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia de Produção, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise de dados comerciais e indicadores de performance, com expertise em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, entre outras).
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel, com habilidades em análise de grandes volumes de dados e automação de relatórios.
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de metas e performance, com visão analítica e estratégica voltada para resultados.
  • Habilidade em interpretação de dados para elaboração de estratégias e tomada de decisão.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades para apresentar informações complexas de forma clara e objetiva.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com acompanhamento de equipes comerciais e definição de recursos necessários para a demanda.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de metas, KPIs e monitoramento de performance comercial.
  • Vivência com planejamento estratégico, análise de viabilidade de novos negócios e definição de orçamentos.

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.
Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.
Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Controlar o estoque mínimo dos produtos por meio de sistema informatizado, assegurando a disponibilidade contínua de materiais e evitando rupturas de estoque;
Conferir as entradas de materiais e notas fiscais no sistema, comparando com os pedidos de compra, e reportar quaisquer divergências identificadas entre o solicitado e o recebido;
Registrar as saídas de materiais, equipamentos e utensílios no sistema, garantindo a acuracidade e a rastreabilidade do estoque;
Receber equipamentos, utensílios e demais materiais, conferindo as notas fiscais e os pedidos de compra, recusando o recebimento em caso de irregularidades ou não conformidades;
Analisar solicitações de materiais com base nos requisitos, normas, procedimentos e na realidade operacional da empresa;
Receber e encaminhar materiais e equipamentos para troca ou manutenção, mediante autorização prévia do gestor responsável;
Manter o ambiente de estoque limpo, organizado e higienizado periodicamente, garantindo boas práticas de armazenagem;
Cumprir e zelar pelo atendimento às normas internas de qualidade, meio ambiente, compliance, saúde e segurança do trabalho, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos;
Controlar e requisitar materiais de expediente e/ou estoque, mediante aprovação prévia e conforme a necessidade dos setores;
Alimentar planilhas ou sistemas de controle com dados coletados conforme demanda, mantendo as informações atualizadas e acessíveis para tomada de decisão.

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE
Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.
Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.
O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de 2.800 colaboradores e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.
Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Informações adicionais

Na Coca-Cola Andina Brasil, nada é tão importante quanto os nossos colaboradores; por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios que permite uma vida mais saudável e completa. Venha conhecer como fazemos a magia acontecer para você:

Sua saúde é nossa prioridade Por isso, oferecemos Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida (conforme elegibilidade ). Além disso, contamos com um Ambulatório Multiprofissional que dispõe de serviços médicos, enfermagem e odontologia próprios (exclusivo nas unidades JPA e RP). Com o suporte de uma equipe especializada da operadora de saúde, dispomos de programas para acompanhamento de doenças crônicas.

E não é só isso; pensando no bem-estar físico, psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico, seu e de toda sua família disponibilizamos o Gympass e o Pack para Você, extensivo a dependentes.

Para dar aquele gás, oferecemos Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição (conforme elegibilidade ). Se você trabalhar em uma das nossas fábricas, temos restaurante.

Para dar um refresco no início do ano e deixar a criançada animada, oferecemos Kit Escolar (conforme elegibilidade).

Para refrescar momentos importantes, temos descontos com aquele gás, Venda ao Colaborador.

Vale Transporte opcional, de acordo com o modelo de trabalho de cada vaga.

Participação nos Resultados da Cia para todos.

Gostamos de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento; aqui, temos diversas iniciativas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento, como Portal do Conhecimento, parcerias com instituições de ensino, entre outras.

#Venha fazer parte do Time e compartilhar Felicidade com a gente

Na Coca-Cola Andina não fazemos distinção de estado civil, situação familiar, deficiência, reabilitação profissional, idade, raça, cor, gênero, etnia, idioma, religião, opinião política, origem nacional ou social e riqueza. A Coca-Cola Andina Brasil é feita de pessoas e prezamos pela diversidade e inclusão, sendo assim, nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, em conformidade com a Lei de Igualdade de Gênero.

Somos a Coca-Cola Andina, uma empresa com mais de 75 anos de história, atuando no Brasil, Argentina, Chile e Paraguai, com o propósito de juntos, chegar a todos os cantos, para refrescar momentos e criar novas oportunidades. A partir deste propósito, refrescamos milhares de consumidores com nossos produtos, sendo líderes na indústria de refrigerantes nos mercados em que operamos.

No Brasil estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais, com três unidades fabris e mais de 20 centros de distribuição e escritórios de vendas. Em Duque de Caxias/RJ temos uma das fábricas mais tecnológicas do mundo.

Desde a garrafa individual, tivemos uma enorme expansão no portfólio de bebidas. Hoje, o grupo distribui mais de 5 milhões de litros de bebidas por ano, levando a felicidade a quase 53 milhões de consumidores, através de 280 mil clientes. Essa magia acontece graças à dedicação e ao esforço diário de quase colaboradores presentes nos quatro países.

title: Technical Advisor – Waste Management
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Technical Advisor reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationHome-based
Expected durationThree (3) months
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. As part of a partnership with the Municipality of São Paulo, "Enhancing inclusivity and sustainability in the city of São Paulo" project includes the elaboration of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan and the Municipal Sanitation Plan. To properly implement the project, a Technical Advisor is required to ensure a good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Technical Advisor reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Technical Advisor will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Offering technical support for the work developed by the UN-Habitat and São Paulo's Municipality teams. b) Assisting in identifying complementary studies and proficiencies necessary for the technical work. c) Providing technical guidance for the solution study, and action plan of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan. d) Guiding analyses and formulate guidelines related to the management of urban solid waste, in accordance with the particularities of the municipality's territorial zoning. e) Provide technical support in the implementation of the project's products and provide technical oversight of product consultancies. f) Contributing to the exchange of information and provide input for the development of products, both internal and external to the project. g) Supporting the revision of technical content prepared by the project team. h) Supporting project risk anticipation and mitigation, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that could affect project development and implementation. i) Providing information for the systematization and exchange of good practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with divisions at headquarters. j) Ensuring that technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of UN-Habitat and partners. k) Participating in meetings organized by partners to strengthen the project's position and presence in the Municipality of São Paulo. l) Participate in other meetings when requested by the project coordination. m) Perform other tasks that may be requested by the project coordination, as long as they are adjusted to the agreed consultancy time. The Technical Advisor will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The Technical Advisor will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Technical Advisor will support the implementation of the above-mentioned initiative. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Bachelor's degree in Sanitation Engineering, Environment Engineering, Civil Engineering, Urban Studies or related fields.
Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Waste Management, Sanitation Engineering, Environment Engineering, Civil Engineering, Public Administration, Public Policy, Urban Studies or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
Six (6) years of experience in project/programme management on issues related to urban and sanitation planning in Brazil is required.
Professional and academic experience on themes related to solid waste management in Brazil is required.
Professional experience in developing waste plans is desired.
Professional experience in designing and conducting participatory activities is desired.
Experience related to UN and/or any other international agency is desirable. Skills:
Good computer skills in the Microsoft Office package (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and Microsoft Teams is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is required.
Experience of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Experience related to online event and conference tools is required. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

title: consultor sap fico s/4hana
description:
O Grupo Granado abre as portas para você

Se você possui perfil analítico e experiência em suporte especializado, esta oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável nos suporte dos módulos FI, CO e FSCM (Gestão de Crédito e Administração de Caixa) do sistema SAP S/4HANA, com projetos completos de acordo com as metodologias oficiais de implementações, sustentações e demais atividades.
  • Criar e gerenciar plano de testes integrados dos cenários de FI (GL,AA, AP, AR), CO, PS e FSCM;
  • Conduzir workshops para definição da estrutura organizacional do módulo, conceituando seus principais elementos, vantagens e desvantagens, conseguindo orientar o cliente na melhor estrutura com base nas melhores práticas do mercado;
  • Configuração de FI (GL, AA, AP, AR), CO e FSCM em SAP versões 6.0 e acima;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa.
  • Experiência sólida em SAP S/4HANA nos módulos FI (GL, AA, AP, AR), CO e FSCM.
  • Domínio em configuração de FI, CO e FSCM, incluindo integração com PS e demais módulos.
  • Conhecimento de Localização Brasileira, abrangendo impostos, processos bancários e integração com sistemas fiscais (ECD, EFD, ECF).
  • Experiência em interfaces via CPI ou API e elaboração de especificações funcionais (WRICEF).
  • Domínio de Migration Cockpit para migração de dados contábeis, fiscais e de BP.
  • Vivência em workshops de definição de estrutura organizacional e planos de testes integrados.
  • Experiência em metodologias de projeto (Agile, Híbrido, Scrum e gestão de histórias de usuários).
  • Desejável Certificação SAP S/4HANA FI e proficiência em Microsoft Office.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Matriz (Centro, RJ), de segunda a sexta-feira.

Informações adicionais

O que voce encontra por aqui:

  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo, onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.
  • Horário flexível, para você fugir do trânsito e aproveitar melhor o seu tempo.
  • Vale-Refeição para curtir bons momentos e conversas descontraídas enquanto saboreia suas refeições.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Afinal, mente sã em corpo são é o que importa
  • Total Pass, para manter o corpo em movimento e a energia sempre lá em cima.
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas, como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados, valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. title: médico pediatra
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do
Hospital Municipal Pedro II
.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O
Centro de Tratamento de Queimados
é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar consultas no Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico, unificando dados contidos em prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; passar em visita aos pacientes internados, avaliando a recuperação dos mesmos; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou título de Especialização na área

Registro ativo no conselho da classe

RQE em Pediatria

Experiência em Pediatria

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

title: Engineer II, Structural
description:
Description

The Engineer II performs engineering design review and analysis assignments, typically involving a significant project or several smaller, less complex projects. These projects, by nature of their complexity and difficulty, require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular field of engineering or science. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintains an active awareness of technical, business, and management developments affecting present and potential customers and communicates this information promptly to the appropriate senior-level managers.

  • Serves as an ABS representative to actively promote the services and capabilities of ABS throughout the business community

  • Initiate, plan, and execute the technology projects. Provide day-to-day leadership of the project team assigned.

  • Assigns tasks to project team members and monitors the progress of all assigned projects

  • Ensures the delivery of high-quality service and maintenance of good customer relations.

  • Develops suggested Rule changes and/or Rule development projects as assigned. Advises assigned staff in matters related to the application of Rules and Regulations

  • Directs the implementation and operation of the ABS

  • Quality System concerning technical work in the assigned jurisdiction

  • Performs selected engineering support and analyses where necessary

  • Advises managers of short-and long-term manpower needs to ensure that qualified, trained technical staff are available as needs arise, and identifies associated training needs

  • Develops or assists in the development of qualification statements, proposals, and bids; makes presentations of these materials to prospective clients when necessary

  • Ensures accurate billing to clients on time

  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements about technical work within the assigned technical area of responsibility are fulfilled

What You Will Need:
 

Education and Experience
 

  • Minimum 6 years of ABS or direct, hands-on maritime-related industry or research experience

  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural Engineering. Mechanical Engineering. Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an advanced degree is preferred


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Excellent command of the English language

  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others

  • A strong background in marine or offshore structures

  • Hands-on experience in performing structural analysis using ABS engineering applications and commercial finite element analysis software

  • Ability to lead project bidding and execution, either independently or in a team setting

  • Ability to perform under pressure and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment

  • Ability to deliver complex messages in simple and understandable ways, both verbally and in writing

  • Essential technical writing skills and experience in preparing formal reports and papers

  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety. Quality, and Environmental Management System
     

Reporting Relationships:
Reports to a Manager or Director.

title: Technical Solutions Architect
description:
Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox


Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói
$36,000 USD/year + equity & benefits

About TestBox


TestBox was founded with a bold mission: to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview


As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You'll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You'll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just "follow the playbook."

To succeed here, you'll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You'll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you'll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities


Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.

Customer Storytelling & Consulting

  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.

Environment Implementation

  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)

AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.

Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven—comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups: ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool, not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text-to-speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI-focused courses, certifications, or hands-on projects.

Why Join TestBox

  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

title: Global Analysis Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?


Would you like to work on industry leading projects?


Join our Team

Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create oilfield equipment is the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.

As a GLOBAL ANALYSIS ENGINEER, you will be responsible for:

  • Responsible for the dynamic modeling and analysis of flexible riser systems to meet Client specifications and industry standards.
  • Assessing environmental and vessel data for implementation into a system model.
  • Providing detailed technical evaluations of riser systems as part of the project execution process.
  • Supporting development of methodologies and produce procedures for riser system analysis.
  • Reviewing, assessing and presenting design documentation results (Metocean Data, mooring reports…).
  • Producing comprehensive analysis reports for submission as part of either FEED study or Project Execution work.
  • Interfacing with the engineering groups both internally and externally on the analysis outputs for the design of the riser system and ancillary equipment, to present a comprehensive technical package.
  • Attending client meetings in relation to the work performed.
  • Ensuring that the applicable engineering aspects of the design, quality and safety requirements are implemented in accordance with BH and statutory requirements.
  • Producing engineering procedures and calculation sheets to further improve BH's methodologies and technical capabilities.
  • Providing technical support to the Sales and Tendering Group as required in conducting system level analysis.
  • Must be able to demonstrate performance in accomplishment of assigned technical programs on a sustained basis either as an individual or member of a technical team.
  • Must be able to contribute to technical improvements through tools development or automation of analysis/procedures.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Hold a degree in Mechanical, Naval Architecture, Civil, Petroleum or related disciplines.
  • Hold active CREA.
  • Have advanced English.
  • Have effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Have good written and spoken communication, proven analytical and organizational ability.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following working patterns:

  • MON-FRI, 7am to 4pm - On-site RETIC (Fundão/RJ)

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Location: RETIC (Fundão/RJ)

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you

title: Oracle BRM Developer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Billing and Revenue Management (BRM) Expert to support our organization in optimizing billing operations and empowering our billing team. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in BRM systems with strong communication and training skills, ensuring the team can effectively manage the billing system to support company's billing processes and help organize and adapt billing team processes and tools to the new billing system.

This role is designed to ensure the billing team not only has access to the right data but also the skills and confidence to use it effectively, with the BRM expert acting as both a technical authority and a trainer.
Key Responsibilities

System Expertise

  • Strong expertise in Oracle BRM, with special focus in the following areas
  • Product Design Center (PDC): configuration for realtime and offline events
  • Integration: Development of opcodes and expose them as REST APIs to manage complex simple and complex billing hierarchies
  • Product Catalog configuration (Oracle Price Design Center, PDC)
  • Invoicing: Invoice, Receipts and Credit Notes templates design (Oracle Analytics Publisher, OAP)
  • Billing Operations: bill cycle execution, financial reporting, troubleshooting
  • Participate in the design and implementation of complex business and technical requirements, ensuring robustness, scalability, and alignment with Oracle's best practices.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, performance tuning, and platform evolution to keep the system resilient and cost-efficient as the business scales.

Training & Enablement

  • Develop and deliver structured training programs for the billing team.
  • Create user guides, documentation, and best practices tailored to non‑technical staff.
  • Conduct workshops and hands‑on sessions with billing team

Operational Support

  • Collaborate with IT and Finance to streamline billing processes.
  • Provide guidance on troubleshooting billing discrepancies and customer disputes.
  • Recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and data access (including use of replicated databases for secure read‑only queries).

Requirements


Must Have

  • Proven technical expertise in Oracle BRM for 3 or more years.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and database query optimization for large datasets.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to train and mentor non‑technical staff.
  • Familiarity with billing operations, financial reporting, and compliance standards.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with attention to detail and data accuracy.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience leading billing teams or training programs.
  • Knowledge of cloud‑based Oracle BRM solutions.
  • Understanding of telecom, subscription‑based billing models and partner / revenue share models.

Benefits


Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.
Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.
Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.
Ser diverso é ser Super
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) — valorizamos diversidade, inclusão e diferentes formas de pensar.

Apuração dos tributos indiretos (ISS, ICMS, IPI) conforme legislação aplicável.
Elaborar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (SCANC, SPED Fiscal, GIA, entre outras).
Analisar e validar informações fiscais provenientes das Notas Fiscais Eletrônicas (NF-e), incluindo contingências.
Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos nos processos internos.
Prestar atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.
Acompanhar e compreender os impactos da Reforma Tributária nos processos e obrigações fiscais em geral.

Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência na área tributária, com foco em tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, IPI, PIS e COFINS) e conhecimento em NFe (xml e regras de validação).
Ferramentas:

description:

Se você sonha em se tornar referência no mercado da estética, ser reconhecida como autoridade técnica, ministrar cursos, palestrar, ensinar, vender com propósito e construir sua imagem profissional atrelada a uma marca forte, essa oportunidade foi desenhada para você.

Na MedEstec, não buscamos apenas alguém para vender equipamentos. Buscamos uma profissional protagonista, que queira aparecer, contribuir, ensinar, influenciar e crescer junto com a empresa, deixando sua marca no mercado da estética avançada.

Sobre a MedEstec

A MedEstec é referência em tecnologias para a área da saúde e estética avançada, atuando com equipamentos e dispositivos como lasers, HIFU, criolipólise, radiofrequência e muito mais. Trabalhamos com marcas de alto padrão e uma proposta de integração entre tecnologia, conhecimento e resultado para profissionais da estética e harmonização facial e corporal.

Seu papel nessa jornada

  • Realizar vendas consultivas e estratégicas, sendo reconhecida como especialista e referência técnica;
  • Ministrar treinamentos técnicos para profissionais da saúde e estética como médicos, estetas e dermatofuncionais
  • Conduzir workshops, aulas práticas e demonstrações em instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação);
  • Desenvolver e ministrar cursos e jornadas técnicas da empresa, com remuneração por bilheteria;
  • Capacitar e desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe comercial interna;
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e acompanhamento aos clientes, fortalecendo relacionamento e resultados;
  • Representar a MedEstec em eventos, cursos e ações de mercado, fortalecendo sua imagem e a da marca;
  • Colaborar com o marketing na criação de conteúdos técnicos, campanhas e materiais, tornando-se um rosto e uma voz da marca no mercado

Buscamos alguém que:

  • Seja graduada na área da saúde, com especialização em Estética ou Dermato-Funcional;
  • Tenha experiência com vendas na área da estética e goste de desafios comerciais;
  • Tenha boa comunicação, didática e presença, goste de ensinar e se posicionar;
  • Deseje aparecer, crescer, ser reconhecida e construir autoridade;
  • Tenha e queira aprofundar experiência com lasers, HIFU micro e macrofocado, criolipólise, radiofrequência, entre outras tecnologias.

O que oferecemos

  • Modelo PJ, com período inicial de 3 meses de experiência e após esse período, contratação no regime CLT
  • Remuneração fixa competitiva
  • Comissões escalonadas e atrativas, alinhadas a performance

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.
YOUR PROFILE

A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
